categories.main_business_segments: Neway CNC Equipment (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of mid-to-high-end CNC machine tools including three-axis, four-axis, five-axis, and above multi-axis CNC machine tools, CNC systems, servo devices, mechanical parts processing automation lines, robots, and machine tool functional components and accessories. The company also provides maintenance, repair, and technical support services related to these products. Its product portfolio includes large machining centers, vertical CNC machine tools, horizontal CNC machine tools, and specialized CNC machines tailored for industries such as automotive, new energy, aerospace, engineering machinery, molds, valves, automation equipment, electronics, and general equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on core technologies in six key areas: machine tool precision and stability, high-speed motion control, fault analysis and resolution, user-friendly operation, complex part processing, and independent development of functional components. It employs advanced manufacturing methods including modular design, CAE simulation optimization, thermal compensation, servo optimization, and multi-axis linkage control. Production follows a 'make-to-order' model with core processes such as precision machining, assembly, testing, and quality inspection controlled internally, while non-core processes like casting rough machining are outsourced. The company also develops key functional components like electric spindles, CNC rotary tables, servo tool holders, and gearboxes to reduce reliance on imports.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Neway CNC serves a diverse customer base across automotive, new energy vehicles, aerospace, engineering machinery, molds, valves, automation equipment, electronics, and general equipment sectors. Its products are used for manufacturing complex metal parts ranging from small components to large-scale workpieces. The company’s customers include both domestic and international clients, with sales covering over 60 countries and regions. The company’s top five customers accounted for 18.2% of total sales in 2024, indicating a broad customer base without excessive dependence on a few clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a strong focus on the Yangtze River Delta region as its key domestic market. It has established a comprehensive sales and service network covering most provinces and regions in China. Internationally, Neway CNC has subsidiaries and sales operations in over 60 countries, including a wholly-owned subsidiary in the United States (Neway CNC USA, Inc.). The company’s overseas sales accounted for approximately 13.9% of total revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Neway CNC operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the CNC machine tool supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and assembles complete CNC machine tools and key functional components, while sourcing some core parts such as CNC systems, rotary tables, tool magazines, and transmission components from international suppliers like FANUC. The company focuses on core technology development and production, outsourcing non-core and less complex processes such as casting rough machining to external vendors to optimize resource allocation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes independent R&D and technological innovation to enhance product performance towards high speed, high precision, high efficiency, intelligence, and environmental sustainability. It invests significantly in R&D, with 296 R&D personnel (21.29% of total employees) and an R&D expenditure ratio of 4.57% of revenue in 2024. Key R&D projects include high-speed five-axis machining centers, heavy-duty precision milling machines, high-precision vertical turning centers, and CNC machines tailored for new energy and aerospace industries. The company aims to reduce reliance on imported core components and achieve import substitution by developing proprietary core functional parts and advancing intelligent manufacturing solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Neway CNC generates revenue primarily through the sale of CNC machine tools and related products. It employs a sales model combining distribution (accounting for 76.51% of revenue) and direct sales, supported by technical application engineers and sales engineers. Revenue is recognized upon delivery, installation, and customer acceptance of products. The company also earns income from after-sales services, technical support, and maintenance. Additionally, it invests idle funds in financial products to generate investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer in the mid-to-high-end CNC metal cutting machine tool segment in China. It competes with international giants from Germany, Japan, and the US, which dominate high-end CNC technology globally. Domestically, Neway CNC is among the top private CNC machine tool manufacturers, benefiting from strong R&D capabilities, a broad product portfolio, and a growing market share amid increasing import substitution trends. The company faces competition from Japanese and Korean manufacturers and other domestic high-end CNC tool producers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Neway CNC reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.46 billion, representing a 6.08% increase over 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 325.16 million, up 2.36% year-over-year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 3.94 billion, an 8% increase from the previous year, with net assets of RMB 1.74 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by increased R&D investment and expanding market presence. Earnings per share stood at RMB 1.00, with a return on equity of 19.83%. The company declared a cash dividend payout ratio of 60.28% for 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Neway CNC emphasizes its strong independent R&D capabilities, comprehensive product range with over 300 models, and advanced core technologies in precision, speed, and intelligent control. The company differentiates itself by offering highly customizable CNC solutions with modular design for rapid response to customer needs, superior after-sales service with a dedicated technical support team, and partial self-production of critical functional components to ensure quality and cost competitiveness. Its products meet stringent industry standards and have received multiple awards, positioning the company as a reliable partner for high-end manufacturing sectors seeking advanced, efficient, and environmentally friendly CNC machining solutions.
